mapper.select: select substring(table_name, length('u_p_receivedetail_') + 1) from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'sdsorder' and table_name like 'u_p_receivedetail_%'

select d.id, d.shop_code, d.detailcode, d.receivecode, d.purchasedetailcode, d.goodscode, d.goodsname, d.spec, d.unit, d.qty, d.actualqty, d.goodqty, d.badqty, d.qualitystatus, d.price, d.amount, d.batchcode, d.serialnumbers, d.inventorydoccode, d.inventorydetailcode, d.remark, d.warehousecode, d.warehousename, coalesce(g.batchstrategy, 'none') as batchstrategy from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d left join sdsshop.u_m_waregoods g on g.shop_code = d.shop_code and g.goodscode = d.goodscode where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and d.receivecode = #{receiveCode} order by d.id
mapper.insert:
insert into sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} (shop_code, detailcode, receivecode, purchasedetailcode, goodscode, goodsname, spec, unit, qty, actualqty, goodqty, badqty, qualitystatus, price, amount, batchcode, serialnumbers, remark, warehousecode, warehousename, createtime) values
(#{item.shopCode}, #{item.detailCode}, #{item.receiveCode}, #{item.purchaseDetailCode}, #{item.goodsCode}, #{item.goodsName}, #{item.spec}, #{item.unit}, #{item.qty}, null, 0, 0, null, #{item.price}, #{item.amount}, null, null, #{item.remark}, #{item.warehouseCode}, #{item.warehouseName}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and receivecode = #{receiveCode}
mapper.update: update sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} set actualqty = #{item.actualQty}, batchcode = #{item.batchCode}, serialnumbers = #{item.serialNumbers}, warehousecode = #{item.warehouseCode}, warehousename = #{item.warehouseName}, inventorydoccode = #{item.inventoryDocCode}, updatetime = sysdate() where shop_code = #{item.shopCode} and detailcode = #{item.detailCode} and actualqty is null
mapper.select: select d.receivecode as receiveCode, date_format(m.senddate, '%Y-%m-%d') as sendDate, d.goodscode as goodsCode, d.goodsname as goodsName, d.spec as spec, d.unit as unit, d.qty as expectQty, d.actualqty as actualQty, d.badqty as shortageQty from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d join sdsorder.u_p_receive_${tableSuffix} m on m.shop_code = d.shop_code and m.receivecode = d.receivecode where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and m.purchasecode = #{purchaseCode} and d.inventorydetailcode is not null and d.badqty > 0 order by d.receivecode, d.id

select d.purchasedetailcode as purchaseDetailCode, coalesce(sum(d.qty), 0) as qty from sdsorder.u_p_receivedetail_${tableSuffix} d where d.shop_code = #{shopCode} and d.inventorydetailcode is null and d.purchasedetailcode in #{code} group by d.purchasedetailcode
